name: OmaCaffeine
author: Peter Sønderby
description: Caffeine tracker for the Omarchy bar: log your espresso, tea or energy drink, watch the cup fill up, and know when to stop so you still sleep tonight.

barWidget.description: Caffeine tracker with a cup that fills up, half-life model and a bedtime cut-off.

schema.label: Body weight (kg)
schema.description: Stored in kg; the panel shows pounds when your locale is imperial. Used for the recommended daily limit (5.7 mg per kg, capped at 400 mg).

schema.label: Typical day
schema.description: Rough activity level. Half-life 5 h sitting, 4.75 h standing, 4.5 h moving around.

schema.label: Optimal bedtime
schema.description: Stored as 24-hour HH:MM; the panel shows and accepts your locale's format.

schema.label: Daily limit (mg)
schema.description: The cup is full at this amount.

schema.label: Caffeine left at bedtime (mg)
schema.description: How much may still be in your system at bedtime. EFSA notes 100 mg close to bedtime may affect sleep.
